sources.summary: Following AMD’s acquisition of MEXT earlier this year, the company has revealed its own IT infrastructure is using the technology to run servers at 50% DRAM capacity while achieving 95% of the performance of a full-DRAM system in certain applications.
sources.summary_zh: AMD 今年早些时候收购了 MEXT 后，该公司透露其自己的 IT 基础设施正在使用该技术以 50% DRAM 容量运行服务器，同时在某些应用中实现全 DRAM 系统 95% 的性能。
